title: OpenInsights Design System Component Generator
description: Generate a new OpenInsights design system component with variants, modifiers, and slots

name.description: The name of the component (e.g., Button, Input, Badge)

variants.description: Comma-separated list of variants in format 'variantName:value1,value2' (e.g., 'intent:primary,secondary,danger size:sm,md,lg')
variants.x-prompt: What variants should this component have? (e.g., 'intent:primary,secondary size:sm,md,lg')

modifiers.x-prompt: What boolean modifiers should this component have? (e.g., 'disabled,loading')

slots.x-prompt: What slots should this component have? (e.g., 'icon,label')

rootElement.description: The default HTML element for the component root

useBaseUI.description: Whether this component should wrap a Base UI primitive

baseUIPrimitive.description: The Base UI primitive to use (e.g., 'Checkbox', 'Switch', 'Select')

isCompound.description: Whether this is a compound component with sub-components

isPublic.description: Whether this component should be exported from the public API

supportsPolymorphism.description: Whether this component supports the 'component' prop for polymorphism

directory.description: Subdirectory within components folder (e.g., 'form' for form components)
